We follow the common practice and evaluate the performance of our models in terms of f-measure at the top N keyphrases (F1@N), and apply stemming to both extracted keyphrases and gold truth.

we evaluate the performance of our models in terms of f-measure at the top N keyphrases (F1@N), and apply stemming to both extracted keyphrases and gold truth. Specifically, we report F1@5, F1@10 and F1@15 of each model on three datasets.
